title: Evidence Manifest Rules
description: Minimum metadata for auditable evidence generated by CLI, MCP, CI, or Tracker.

rules.title: Evidence Has Stable Identity
rules.description: Every evidence item MUST include id, source, generatedAt, producer, and related rule or gate.
rules.validationQuery: Validate evidence manifests contain id, source, generatedAt, producer, and relatedRuleIds or relatedGateId.

rules.title: Evidence Links to Source Artifact
rules.description: Every evidence item MUST link to the source artifact, command, CI run, or external system record that produced it.
rules.validationQuery: Verify sourceRef is present and resolvable.

rules.title: Evidence Captures Validation Outcome
rules.description: Every evidence item MUST capture status, evaluated rules, blocking failures, and waiver reference when applicable.
rules.validationQuery: Verify status, evaluatedRules, blockingFailures, and waiverRef fields.

rules.title: Evidence Declares Retention Expectation
rules.description: Evidence SHOULD declare retention period and accountable owner for audit follow-up.
